method.note: WebFetch and curl are blocked in this environment (EGRESS_BLOCKED / HTTP 000). firecrawl_search was the only route. Full page markdown came back reliably only for the site root; every other URL returned a Google-style SERP snippet in `description`. Snippets were widened by re-querying the same page with different long-tail phrases. Fragments are therefore partial page copy, not complete pages — the trailing ellipsis in a fragment is the snippet truncation, not the site's.
